about: Every command in Tests/Userland/commands.cpp whose output is different on a real Mac, and why. Meta/oracle-test.sh fails on a difference that isn't here.

differences.why: Each says what's wrong in its own words. It's stopped with the same status either way, and nothing reads these.
This system is called vultureOS, and has its own version numbers.
Tests run as root here, and root hears about processes in general: it's what a Mac says to root too.
macOS 26 says 'tar: absent.tar: m: No such file or directory', which looks like a mistake. This says what libarchive has always said.
The test programs run with vlaunchd in its test mode, with no name service to ask. Meta/harness-test.sh's full boot checks launchctl itself.
